title: Accordion configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.AccordionAPI.Create, parsed. Invalid values fall back to the defaults at runtime; unknown properties are ignored. Generated by scripts/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

MultipleItems.description: Allows several items to be expanded at once; when false, expanding an item collapses the others.

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
